record_type_quote: Here, of course, we report both: three direct replications (Studies 1a, 1b, and 1c) and two conceptual replications (Study 2a and 2b).

targets.title: Insurance, risk, and magical thinking
targets.evidence_quote: In three studies, we attempted to replicate the protection effect reported in Tykocinski's (2008) Experiment 1 as closely as possible.
targets.outcome_quote: In three studies, we attempted to replicate the protection effect reported in Tykocinski's (2008) Experiment 1 as closely as possible. Using a student sample, a sample of train commuters (as in the original study), and a large online U.S. sample, we did not find evidence for this effect. In a follow-up study in which we tried to conceptually replicate the protection effect we also did not find support for it.

targets.title: Why people are reluctant to tempt fate
targets.evidence_quote: Our attempt to replicate the tempting fate effect reported in Risen and Gilovich (2008) was aimed at testing whether we could find a different magical thinking effect.
targets.outcome_quote: We thus think that the successful replication of the tempting fate effect adds credibility to the non-replication of the protection effect.
